hero.tagline: Building things at the intersection of code, craft, and deep water.

bio: I'm a computer science student obsessed with the boundary between engineering and art. I build tools that feel alive — trading platforms, civic tech, and right now, an underwater 3D world called Atlantis.
When I'm not writing code I'm designing the lore for that world, playing football, or hunting golden-hour light with a battered camera lens. I believe software should make people feel something.
